item.title: Downtown building to be put to new use
item.description: Space will house antiques store and gym, as well as batting cages for owner’s boys

item.title: Freeborn Bank, Jacobson buildings seeing new life
item.description: With the 2nd floor in the Freeborn National Bank and Jacobson Apartments buildings almost full, owners looking for tenants for upper floors

item.title: Firefighters respond to shed fire and other reports
item.description: The Geneva and Clarks Grove fire departments responded to a report of a shed fire at 5:38 p.m. Tuesday at 33032 795th Ave. in Ellendale.

item.title: Boutique owners recognized as Citizens of the Year
item.description: At both their highs and lows — and the days in-between — Angela and Matt Moller have inspired the community to let love prevail.

item.title: 'It keeps us all busy': Siblings take over parents’ excavating company, now have 3 businesses serving the area
item.description: Anyone who drove down Broadway Avenue in Albert Lea in January likely noticed the heavy demolition work being done to take down the old Broadway Theater building. This was the handiwork of Dulas Excavating Inc., a Wells company.

item.title: Man charged for role in attempted ATM 'jackpotting' attack
item.description: A Florida man was charged Tuesday in Freeborn County District Court in what authorities say was part of an alleged ATM ‘jackpotting’ attempt in Albert Lea.

item.title: Bethany Linn LaFavre
item.description: Bethany Linn LaFavre, age 35, of Lakeville, Minnesota, went to be with her Savior on February 26, 2026.

item.title: Sheriff's Office seeks security footage from Clarks Grove residents after reported gunshots Tuesday night
item.description: The Freeborn County Sheriff’s Office is asking for help from Clarks Grove residents for information tied to possible gunshots fired Tuesday night in the city.

item.title: Information, concerns shared at public hearing on permit for battery energy storage system
item.description: Environmental impacts, property values and quality of life were topics at the forefront of a public hearing held Tuesday at the Glenville-Emmons High School to discuss the possibility of the construction of the Midwater Battery Energy Storage System in Freeborn County.

item.title: ‘We hope that audiences will be enchanted’ — Alden-Conger School to bring classic musical to the stage
item.description: Students of all ages this weekend will perform a familiar favorite as they bring “Rodgers and Hammerstein’s Cinderella, Youth Edition,” to the stage at Alden-Conger School.
